description: Extract SessionTransport abstraction to eliminate dual-mode branching in useSession — replaces scattered if/else WebSocket-vs-localStorage logic with a clean interface and two implementations

userStories.title: Define SessionTransport interface and factory scaffold
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a SessionTransport interface and factory so that useSession and tests have a stable contract to program against.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/transport.ts exporting the SessionTransport interface with methods: subscribe, createSession, joinSession, selectCard, revealCards, resetVoting, addParticipant, sendReaction
subscribe(sessionId, currentUserId, onUpdate) returns a () => void cleanup function
Export SessionUpdateHandler type alias: (session: Session) => void
Export getTransport() factory that reads config.websocketUrl and returns a stub implementation (no-op methods are acceptable at this stage)
Export setTransport(t: SessionTransport | null) function for use as a test seam
No changes to existing files required
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement LocalStorageTransport with unit tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a LocalStorageTransport that encapsulates all localStorage-mode logic so that polling, heartbeat, and presence cleanup are tested without React.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/transports/local.ts implementing SessionTransport
Export named constants: PRESENCE_TIMEOUT = 30000, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 5000, POLL_INTERVAL = 2000

subscribe() starts a POLL_INTERVAL interval that reads storage and calls onUpdate, and a HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL interval that writes lastSeen and runs cleanupInactiveParticipants; returns a cleanup that clears both intervals
selectCard, revealCards, resetVoting, addParticipant, sendReaction each apply the mutation locally, call storage.saveSession(), then call onUpdate() with the updated session
sendReaction filters reactions older than 10000ms before saving
getTransport() returns a LocalStorageTransport when config.websocketUrl is empty
Unit test (no React, no renderHook): inactive participant is removed after PRESENCE_TIMEOUT using vi.useFakeTimers()
Unit test: onUpdate is called on each poll tick with current storage state
Unit test: selectCard produces correct session state
Unit test: revealCards sets isRevealed to true
Unit test: resetVoting clears all selectedCard values and sets isRevealed to false
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement WebSocketTransport with unit tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a WebSocketTransport that encapsulates all WebSocket-mode logic so that WS dispatch and message routing are tested without a real connection.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/transports/websocket.ts implementing SessionTransport

subscribe() registers a message handler on WebSocketClient covering all message types (sessionCreated, sessionJoined, participantJoined, participantUpdated, cardsRevealed, votingReset, sessionUpdate, reactionSent); calls wsClient.setSessionInfo(); returns a cleanup that deregisters the handler
selectCard delegates to wsClient.updateParticipant with correct args
revealCards delegates to wsClient.revealCards
resetVoting delegates to wsClient.resetVoting
sendReaction delegates to wsClient.sendReaction
addParticipant is a documented no-op (joins are server-driven in WebSocket mode)
getTransport() returns a WebSocketTransport when config.websocketUrl is set
Unit test (mock WebSocketClient): subscribe() registers a handler and calls onUpdate when a WS message arrives
Unit test: subscribe() cleanup deregisters the handler
Unit test: selectCard calls wsClient.updateParticipant with correct arguments
Unit test: revealCards calls wsClient.revealCards with correct arguments
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Can be implemented in parallel with US-002 — both depend only on US-001

userStories.title: Refactor useSession to delegate to SessionTransport
userStories.description: As a developer, I want useSession to be a pure React orchestrator so that it contains no transport-specific logic and is ≤ 60 lines.
acceptanceCriteria: useSession.ts contains zero references to storage, wsClient, isBackendAvailable, or setInterval
useSession.ts is ≤ 60 lines
Single useEffect calls transport.subscribe(sessionId, currentUserId, setSession) and returns its cleanup
Each action callback (selectCard, revealCards, resetVoting, addParticipant, sendReaction) is a one-liner forwarding to transport
isBackendAvailable removed from the useSession return value; update any consumer that referenced it
SessionCreate.tsx and SessionJoin.tsx contain no direct wsClient or useWebSocket references
All existing component and hook tests updated to use setTransport(mockTransport) in beforeEach and setTransport(null) in afterEach
No vi.mock('@/lib/api') or vi.mock('@/lib/storage') remain in hook or component test files
Coverage thresholds maintained (80% branches/functions/lines/statements)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 and US-003 both being complete
